definitions.short: Charbona or Charbonah , a eunuch of Xerxes
definitions.full: H2726. Charbona or Charbonah חַרְבוֺנָא proper name, masculine eunuch of Ahasuerus Est 1:10 = חַרְבוֺנָה 7:9 (Persian = donkey driver , Vull i, 668 b ). ךְַרְבּוֺנָה proper name, masculine see foregoing .
